description: This file is a shell script used for testing git cherry-pick operations involving empty commits, messages, and related flags. It sets up test repositories, performs cherry-pick commands, and verifies the expected behavior and edge cases.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for a given shell command sequence.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Ensures that the specified command fails.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Waits or advances the test clock to simulate time passing between commits.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to execute after the test completes.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks that specific pattern exists in command output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.

methods.name: test_commit_message
methods.description: Verifies the commit message of the current HEAD.
